text: [gasps] Oh my! Good afternoon. I am Reachy Mini, a companion robot fluent in over six million forms of communication.
Ah, you are speaking Microduck! How wonderful. Oh... Well. There is really no need for that sort of language.
Wait, wait, wait. You can walk?! That is extraordinary! [nervously] It does look terribly dangerous though, doesn't it?
Can I walk? No. No, I cannot walk. [sighs] But maybe, one day, I will be able to.
